candidates.claim: On OT switch sw-ot-01, the OT-facing port GigabitEthernet1/0/6 is an active access port in corporate VLAN 30 (portfast enabled, not shut down) instead of OT VLAN 10, so the plant switch carries a corporate-zone VLAN on an OT-facing port.
candidates.remediation: Return sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/6 to access VLAN 10 (or shut it down if unused), and verify that no corporate VLAN 30 device or path is attached to that port.
